contentHtml:
In Omshree Sidha Hospital we have very special and effective herbal combinations to reduce the accumulated excessive fats in the body and overweight. The duration of the treatment would be from 21 -28 days or more. Our special treatment includes Abhyangam (massage), Podikizhi, Swedanam (medicated steam bath), Udwarthanam (massaging using herbal powder). We also have specially prepared medicines for external and internal application. As diet plays an important role in the treatment of obesity and overweight, you are requested to strictly follow our special diet, which would definitely help to reduce the Fat and weight. If you strictly follow our instructions, you will be benefited, which may be more than your expectations. You can go to our testimonials page, there you can see the patients experience with their names and address, (photo if available) some of them may be known to you, or you may have some close friends near to them. You can enquire personally.

Over weight is the excess body fat, which is more than the optimum level of body fat. Body Mass Index (BMI) is used to identify over weight of a person. It is calculated using a person’s height and weight. BMI equals persons weight in kilograms and is divided by their in meters squared. Overweight is defined as a BMI of 25 or more, thus it includes pre-obesity defined as a BMI between 25 and 30 and obesity as defined by a BMI of 30 or more. Our body weight is determined by the amount of energy that we take in as food and the amount of energy we expend in the activities of our day. . Obesity may have severe effects on health leading to reduced life expectancy. It increases the likelihood of various diseases such as Diabetes, Heart disease, Osteoarthritis, certain types cancer etc. it might have adverse effect on both physical and mental conditions. Obesity is caused due to the excess amount of food energy intake, lack of physical activity and genetic susceptibility. Increased use of medications (that can cause weight gain), pregnancy at a later age, epigenetic risk factors passed on generations etc contribute to overweight and obesity. It is very important to treat obesity as it leads to many chronic illnesses.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Obesity. We have our own special medicines for internal and external applications. Medicines vary with condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these medicines.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will feel relaxed and energetic.
  2. On an average you may loss 0.5Kg to 1 Kg in a day, it vary from person to person.
  3. Our medications for Overweight and Obesity will help to remove toxins, inflammation, stiffness etc… and makes your body more attractive and healthy.
  4. Your work efficiency will increase.
  5. In our treatment there is no risky operation or like that.  It is 100% safe and protects your health.
  6. You will become more attractive and efficient.
  7. You may feel energetic and healthy.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient have to undergo the therapy for three to four weeks, rare cases the duration may increase.
